title: VerificationPolicyV1
description: Content-addressed rules defining what "verified" means for a Spend Attestation. Unreleased draft schema (object-model artifact, board step OM4); no existing schema references this artifact yet. Adding a `verificationPolicyHash` binding to SpendAttestation, SpendAttestationToken, or SpendAttestationCredential is a separate, later-sliced change (OM5) and is intentionally NOT made by this schema.
$comment: Derived from README.md#core-objects ("VerificationPolicy | Trust | Content-addressed rules defining what 'verified' means.") and 05-reward-and-settlement/policy-layer.md#hashing, which defines the repository's one existing content-address convention for a policy artifact: RFC 8785 canonical JSON serialization + SHA-256 over the UTF-8 canonical bytes, with `"sha256:" + lowercaseHex` as the recommended id form over legacy bare hex (policy-layer.md: 'Policy artifacts MUST be hashed using: RFC 8785 canonical JSON serialization ... SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes ... Recommended string form: policyId = "sha256:" + <64 hex>.'). No normative document in this repository enumerates the concrete rule content of a verification policy (grep for 'receipt age', 'total bounds', 'CBSA rule' tied to a policy object returns no hits outside this schema); `rules` is therefore left open/minimal rather than invented. See the OM4 PR body 'open points' list for what remains undefined, including how this artifact's id relates to the `verificationVersion` string already carried by Hard Verification (02-proof-lifecycle/hard-verification.md) and canonicalization.md's determinism clause.

policyId.description: Content address of the canonicalized policy: sha256: + lowercaseHex(SHA-256(RFC8785_canonicalize(rules))), following the hashing convention in 05-reward-and-settlement/policy-layer.md#hashing (the repository's only existing precedent for hashing a policy-shaped artifact).

policyVersion.description: Version label for this policy. A change to `rules` produces a new `policyId` and SHOULD accompany a new `policyVersion`. OPEN POINT: no normative source defines whether `policyVersion` is a semantic version, a monotonic counter, or a free-form label.

effectiveFrom.description: When this policy version becomes the version an issuer may cite. OPEN POINT: no normative source ties this to a specific attestation field yet.

previousPolicyId.description: policyId of the immediately prior version in this policy's evolution, or null for the first version. OPEN POINT: unlike IssuerRegistrySnapshot (which has a normatively described sequence/equivocation model), no normative source in this repository describes a policy version series, so this field is a minimal, non-load-bearing placeholder for chaining.

rules.description: OPEN POINT: this repository does not yet normatively enumerate verification-policy rule content. Left open/extensible on purpose so this schema does not invent structure the prose does not support; do not treat this shape as complete.
